cards.card_text: Isaac blesses him: may God give him the dew of heaven and the richness of the earth, with plenty of grain and new wine.

cards.snippet: …covered the camp, and in the morning there was a layer of dew around the camp.

cards.snippet: When the dew fell on the camp at night, the manna would fall with it.

cards.card_text: Then Moses says Israel dwells ___ in a land of grain and new wine, where even the heavens drip with dew.
cards.verse_text: So Israel dwells securely; the fountain of Jacob lives untroubled in a land of grain and new wine, where even the heavens drip with dew.
cards.snippet: …land of grain and new wine, where even the heavens drip with dew.

cards.card_text: How much dew does he wring out of it?
cards.verse_text: When Gideon arose the next morning, he squeezed the fleece and wrung out the dew—a bowlful of water.
cards.snippet: …arose the next morning, he squeezed the fleece and wrung out the dew—a bowlful of water.

cards.card_text: Gideon says to God, "Do not be angry with me; let me speak one more time." True or false: For his second test, he asks God to make the fleece dry and the ground covered with dew.
cards.verse_text: This time let it be dry, and the ground covered with dew.”
cards.snippet: This time let it be dry, and the ground covered with dew.”

cards.card_text: That night God does it: only the fleece is dry, and dew covers the ground.
cards.verse_text: Only the fleece was dry, and dew covered the ground.
cards.snippet: Only the fleece was dry, and dew covered the ground.

cards.card_text: Then David speaks to the mountains of Gilboa: may they have no dew or rain, no fields yielding offerings of grain.
cards.verse_text: O mountains of Gilboa, may you have no dew or rain, no fields yielding offerings of grain.
cards.snippet: O mountains of Gilboa, may you have no dew or rain, no fields yielding offerings of grain.

cards.card_text: Hushai says they'll descend on David like dew on the ground, and not one of his men will remain.
cards.verse_text: Then we will attack David wherever we find him, and we will descend on him like dew on the ground.
cards.snippet: …David wherever we find him, and we will descend on him like dew on the ground.

cards.card_text: No dew or rain except at his word No harvest until Ahab tears down his altar An army will soon surround Samaria
cards.verse_text: Now Elijah the Tishbite, who was among the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As surely as the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there will be neither dew nor rain in these years except at my word!”
cards.snippet: …God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there will be neither dew nor rain in these years except at my word!”

cards.card_text: And men waited silently for his counsel, and his speech settled on them like dew.
cards.verse_text: After my words, they spoke no more; my speech settled on them like dew.
cards.snippet: …my words, they spoke no more; my speech settled on them like dew.

cards.card_text: Then David paints it in big pictures: holy splendor, the womb of the dawn, the dew of Your youth.
cards.verse_text: Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.
cards.snippet: …holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.

cards.card_text: It's like the dew of Hermon, a mountain (Deuteronomy 3:8), falling on the mountains of Zion, the City of David (2 Samuel 5:7).
cards.verse_text: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion.
cards.snippet: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion.

cards.card_text: Right after the dew falling on the mountains of Zion, David says the LORD has bestowed a blessing there.
cards.verse_text: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion.
cards.snippet: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion.

cards.card_text: And by that same knowledge, the clouds dripped with dew.
cards.verse_text: By His knowledge the watery depths were broken open, and the clouds dripped with dew.
cards.snippet: …knowledge the watery depths were broken open, and the clouds dripped with dew.

cards.card_text: But the king's favor is like dew on the grass.

cards.snippet: …is like the roar of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

cards.verse_text: My head is drenched with dew, my hair with the dampness of the night.”

cards.snippet: …dwelling place, like shimmering heat in the sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”
